reference: Eulogius de Córdoba, Memoriale sanctorum, lib. II, cap. XIV (PL 115; sección cerca de la col. 880, aprox.)
gist_en: Eulogius says either that no one afterwards dared to report a Christian who cursed the pseudo-prophet Muhammad, or that before the Saracens allowed it, they killed such Christians at once without public trial.
why_excluded: Its point concerns insults to Muhammad and the killing of Christians who insulted him (provocation and violence), not Islamic doctrine; falls under the exclusion rule. Read in OCR; the Latin text is in the PL 115 OCR (search 'pseudoprophete Mahometo maledicentem').
